+"""Vision-guided controller for the RoboCasa GR1 placemat-to-basket episode.
+
+Run this file once. It keeps one Robot client connected and accepts one JSON
+request per line on stdin. All target positions accepted by move_world are in
+world coordinates; the service receives base-frame ee_pose targets.
+
+Requests:
+  {"op":"observe", "cams":[...], "depth":true}
+  {"op":"move_world", "right":[x,y,z], "left":[x,y,z],
+   "duration":1.0, "hands_right":[six values], "hands_left":[six values],
+   "right_rot":[rx,ry,rz], "left_rot":[rx,ry,rz]}
+  {"op":"move_base", "right":[x,y,z,rx,ry,rz], "left":[...],
+   "duration":1.0, "hands_right":[six values], "hands_left":[six values]}
+
+Only fields supplied are changed. A move holds one absolute target for the
+requested duration, with the native controller interpolating from its last
+command. This small REPL lets the operator inspect each fresh camera view
+before choosing the next motion.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import math
+import pathlib
+import sys
+import time
+
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = pathlib.Path("/app/runs")
+OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+CAMERA_SET = [
+    "robot0_agentview_center", "robot0_agentview_left", "robot0_agentview_right",
+    "egoview", "robot0_eye_in_right_hand", "robot0_eye_in_left_hand",
+]
+# Fixed robot base pose supplied by the eai-standard/2.1 task.
+BASE_T_WORLD = np.array([2.66969, -2.13364, 0.89794], dtype=float)
+R_WORLD_BASE = np.array([[0., -1., 0.], [1., 0., 0.], [0., 0., 1.]])
+R_BASE_WORLD = R_WORLD_BASE.T
+
+
+def world_to_base(p):
+    return R_BASE_WORLD @ (np.asarray(p, dtype=float) - BASE_T_WORLD)
+
+
+def base_to_world(p):
+    return R_WORLD_BASE @ np.asarray(p, dtype=float) + BASE_T_WORLD
+
+
+def pixel_to_world(uv, depth, intrinsic_cv, cam2world_gl):
+    """Unproject an RGB/depth pixel (depth is camera-axis metres)."""
+    u, v = map(float, uv)
+    z = float(depth)
+    K, T = np.asarray(intrinsic_cv), np.asarray(cam2world_gl)
+    q_gl = np.array([(u-K[0, 2])*z/K[0, 0], -(v-K[1, 2])*z/K[1, 1], -z, 1.])
+    return (T @ q_gl)[:3]
+
+
+class Controller:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.r = Robot()
+        self.spec = self.r.spec()
+        self.dt = float(self.spec["control_dt"])
+        self.k = 0
+        self.last_action = None
+        self.last_obs = None
+        print(json.dumps({"event": "connected", "protocol": self.spec["protocol"],
+                          "dt": self.dt, "cameras": list(self.spec["cameras"]),
+                          "budget": self.spec.get("budget")}), flush=True)
+        self.observe({"cams": CAMERA_SET, "depth": True})
+
+    def observe(self, request):
+        cams = request.get("cams", CAMERA_SET)
+        obs = self.r.get_obs(cameras=cams, include_depth=bool(request.get("depth", False)), video="none")
+        self.last_obs = obs
+        self._refresh_action(obs)
+        self.k += 1
+        path = OUT / f"obs_{self.k:03d}"
+        obs.save(str(path))
+        p = obs.meta.get("proprio", {}).get("now", [])
+        lay = obs.meta.get("proprio", {}).get("layout", [])
+        vals = dict(zip(lay, p))
+        print(json.dumps({"event": "observation", "saved": str(path),
+                          "time_left_s": obs.meta.get("time_left_s"),
+                          "control_steps": obs.meta.get("control_steps"),
+                          "done": obs.done,
+                          "eef_world": {"left": [vals.get("eef_left_x"), vals.get("eef_left_y"), vals.get("eef_left_z")],
+                                        "right": [vals.get("eef_right_x"), vals.get("eef_right_y"), vals.get("eef_right_z")]},
+                          "cameras": list(obs.last)}, flush=True)
+
+    def _refresh_action(self, obs):
+        now = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
+        # The final 24 proprio fields are the previous absolute pose and hand commands.
+        self.last_action = now[-24:].copy()
+
+    def move(self, request, world=False):
+        if self.last_action is None:
+            raise RuntimeError("observe first")
+        action = self.last_action.copy()
+        for side, sl in (("right", slice(0, 6)), ("left", slice(6, 12))):
+            if side not in request:
+                continue
+            pose = np.asarray(request[side], dtype=float)
+            if world:
+                if pose.shape != (3,):
+                    raise ValueError(f"{side} world position must have 3 numbers")
+                rot = np.asarray(request.get(side + "_rot", action[sl][3:6]), dtype=float)
+                action[sl] = np.r_[world_to_base(pose), rot]
+            else:
+                if pose.shape != (6,):
+                    raise ValueError(f"{side} base pose must have 6 numbers")
+                action[sl] = pose
+        for side, sl in (("right", slice(12, 18)), ("left", slice(18, 24))):
+            key = "hands_" + side
+            if key in request:
+                hand = np.asarray(request[key], dtype=float)
+                if hand.shape != (6,):
+                    raise ValueError(f"{key} must have 6 numbers")
+                action[sl] = hand
+        duration = float(request.get("duration", 1.0))
+        rows = max(1, int(math.ceil(duration / self.dt)))
+        if rows * self.dt > float(self.spec["max_chunk_s"]):
+            raise ValueError("requested move exceeds max_chunk_s")
+        result = self.r.submit("ee_pose", np.repeat(action[None, :], rows, axis=0),
+                               dt=self.dt, interpolate="linear", cameras=request.get("cams", CAMERA_SET),
+                               video="none", include_depth=bool(request.get("depth", False)),
+                               note=request.get("note", "vision-guided move"))
+        self.last_obs = result
+        self._refresh_action(result)
+        self.k += 1
+        path = OUT / f"obs_{self.k:03d}"
+        result.save(str(path))
+        print(json.dumps({"event": "move_complete", "saved": str(path),
+                          "requested_duration_s": duration, "executed_rows": result.meta.get("executed_rows"),
+                          "control_steps": result.meta.get("control_steps"),
+                          "time_left_s": result.meta.get("time_left_s"), "done": result.done,
+                          "reason": result.meta.get("reason"),
+                          "right_target_base": action[:6].tolist(),
+                          "left_target_base": action[6:12].tolist(),
+                          "right_hand": action[12:18].tolist(), "left_hand": action[18:24].tolist()}, flush=True)
+
+    def loop(self):
+        for line in sys.stdin:
+            line = line.strip()
+            if not line:
+                continue
+            try:
+                req = json.loads(line)
+                op = req.pop("op", "")
+                if op == "observe":
+                    self.observe(req)
+                elif op == "move_world":
+                    self.move(req, world=True)
+                elif op == "move_base":
+                    self.move(req, world=False)
+                elif op == "status":
+                    print(json.dumps({"event": "status", **self.r.status()}), flush=True)
+                elif op == "quit":
+                    print(json.dumps({"event": "client_closing"}), flush=True)
+                    break
+                else:
+                    raise ValueError("op must be observe, move_world, move_base, status or quit")
+            except Exception as exc:
+                print(json.dumps({"event": "error", "type": type(exc).__name__, "message": str(exc)}), flush=True)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    Controller().loop()
